actions.cancelHint: Stop waiting; the app keeps running in the background

hint.idle: Not started yet. Click “Start” and its window shows up here.
hint.running: It is already running in the background. Click “Open” to bring its window here.
hint.missing: No executable found. Choose an .exe, or remove it from the list.
hint.error: Could not bring its window in. Details below; a cold IDE start can take a minute or two.
hint.note: Leaving this page tucks the window away (the app keeps running). Closing the workbench returns it to the desktop.
hint.starting: Launching the app — a cold start can take up to a minute
hint.waiting: The app is up; waiting for its window to appear (click “Cancel wait” to stop)
hint.closing: Ending the process and releasing its window

library.title: App library
library.search: Search apps, windows or process names…
library.emptyInstalled: Nothing found. Switch to “Choose file” and pick an .exe.
library.scanFailed: The scan failed (the system may have refused access). Try “Rescan”, or switch to “Choose file” and pick an .exe.
library.runningEmpty: No app windows are open right now.
library.runningHint: Windows that are open right now and can move into the workbench.
library.more: {{total}} more — type to narrow it down
library.fileHint: Pick an .exe to open, for apps the library could not find.
library.footer: One click adds it and opens it right away

error.title: Could not bring its window in
error.plain: It may still be starting, or its window sits in the system tray. Point at the window to embed manually, or try again later.

warn.not-child: The app restored its own window — re-adopting…
warn.minimized: The window is still minimized, hence the blank area
warn.maximized: The app maximized itself again — forcing a restore…
warn.invisible: The app hid its own window, hence the blank area
warn.size: The window has a zero width/height, hence the blank area
warn.size-mismatch: The window did not fill the area (the app clamped its own size) — click “Restore window” to retry.
warn.restore-failed: Could not restore the window — attach it again.
warn.kill-failed: The kill was refused by the OS; the app stays embedded.

picker.title: Pick the window to embed — {{name}}
picker.hint: This page moves the app's own window in here for you, usually automatically. You only need to point at it here when the automatic choice is wrong — e.g. a splash or helper window got embedded and the real window is still on the desktop.
picker.empty: No embeddable window found for process “{{process}}”. The app may not be running, or its main window is tucked into the system tray; open it from the tray, then refresh below.
picker.search: Search title, class, handle or process…
picker.visibleTip: “Windows on the desktop” are usually the main window you want; the hidden ones below can be embedded too — picking one reveals it.

slot.split: Show two apps side by side
slot.bEmpty: Pick an app for this pane
slot.bNotRunning: No embeddable window right now. Make it primary, start it there, and its window lands here automatically.

storage.warn: Settings could not be saved (storage full or blocked) — they will be lost on restart

kill.title: Close app
kill.message: This ends every {{name}} process. Unsaved work may be lost.

remove.title: Remove app
remove.message: Remove {{name}} from this list? Nothing is uninstalled or deleted.
